reviews.text:
We’ve been bringing our dog Piper to James for the past three years, and we truly couldn’t imagine going anywhere else. He consistently does a fantastic job. Piper always comes home looking amazing, perfectly groomed, and so happy.

James is incredibly professional, patient, and clearly cares so much about the dogs he works with. It gives us such peace of mind knowing Piper is in such kind and capable hands every time. The consistency, attention to detail, and genuine care are unmatched.

We highly, highly recommend James to anyone looking for a skilled and trustworthy groomer, he’s the best! 🐾✨

I highly recommend Stanley Bark for dog grooming! They are professional, priced very reasonable, and friendly. I have been taking my dog Lila here for around 2 years and wouldn’t take her anywhere else. She tends to be anxious around new people but warmed up right away to James. I also just brought London for her first groom and she seems very happy! Thank you again!
They were so gentle with my 4 pound chihuahua trimming her nails. Went there until she was 17! Highly recommend!

Just took our doggo to see James today for her first professional groom ever, at 4.5 years old. She strutted out of there with all the happy sass possible from a husky-ish pooch, and was apparently great for him. That in itself says a lot, because she is great at reading people and wouldn't have put up with grooming from anybody she didn't trust fully. She smells great, her nails are trimmed and filed perfectly, and she's enjoying the coziest nap on the couch after her suuuuuper rough spa day at Stanley Bark. Thanks folks! See you in a few months!

James is wonderful with my timid chi-minpin. Mischa has been going here since she was a puppy, for nails trim. He’s fast, thorough, patient. Winnie is also friendly & they always have time for a quick walk-in, just call ahead.

We recently brought our Malamute-Husky mix, Katsu, in for a grooming session, and I couldn’t be more thrilled with the results! From start to finish, the team was fantastic—Katsu’s coat is shiny, soft, and looks amazing, and his shedding is finally under control! It’s such a relief to see him looking and feeling his best. A huge thank you to the wonderful staff for taking such great care of him. We’re already looking forward to our next visit! Highly recommend this place to any pet owner who wants their dog to look and feel their best!

James and all the staff were super nice and very accommodating. James is a Pro in dog handling. I have a very scared and reactive maltese who doesn’t want to be touch except us.James did his best in grooming him fully with lots of patience. We will definitely be coming back to this grooming place even if we’re from Vancouver Island. Well recommended grooming place!❤️
I took my puppy there for his first grooming service and James was just awesome.

We always love coming to see James at Stanley Bark! He does such an amazing job with our big boy! Highly recommend if you’re looking for a dog groomer who knows what they are doing and does an excellent job! Having been coming here for 3 years and will be back again!
